legal_units.title: Specified income.
legal_units.text: Specified Income: Any anonymous donation received by a registered non-profit organisation other than a registered nonprofit organisation created or established,— (i) wholly for religious purposes, (ii) wholly for charitable and religious purposes (excluding anonymous donation made with a specific direction that such donation is for any university or other educational institution or any hospital; or other medical institution run by such registered non-profit organisation), excluding the anonymous donations up to Rs. 100000 or 5% of the total donations received by it during the tax year, whichever is higher.; Tax Year: Tax year in which such anonymous donation is received.
